settings.heading: Egypt's destination for luxury makeup
settings.body: For more than a decade, Sofie's Makeup Store has been Egypt's trusted home for luxury makeup. We curate the world's most coveted prestige brands so you can shop with confidence — every product 100% authentic, sourced from authorized channels.

settings.body: From Rare Beauty and Charlotte Tilbury to NARS, Huda Beauty, Makeup by Mario, Hourglass, Laura Mercier, Glossier, Saie and more — discover the luxury beauty the world is talking about, in Egypt.
